verdict.rationale: LocalAI's CLI supports listing gallery models (`local-ai models list`), running/downloading models directly by reference (`local-ai run huggingface://...`, `ollama://gemma:2b`), and preloading models via config, covering search/download/run from the command line. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated 'uninstall/remove model' CLI command or independent hands-on verification of the CLI workflow beyond docs.
